title: Limit what a tool may do per server and per workspace repository
notes: --allow read|write|admin on mcp and board; access = read|write|admin on a workspace repository, applied to every change made through the workspace.
result: --allow read|write|admin on mcp and board, and access = read|write|admin on a workspace repository, checked where the command settles the repository it changes, so the board, MCP and the command line all obey it
evidence: pytest: 1363 tests at 100% coverage, ruff, mypy --strict and codeality clean; tests/test_target_path.py, test_access_allows.py, test_board_calls.py (a read repository refuses the board's add)
